# Three.js r181.2

The WebGL renderer and shared core are the prebuilt, unchanged modules from the MIT-licensed [`three@0.181.2` npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/three/v/0.181.2). Petverse loads both modules from this directory so the arcade can serve the game on GitHub Pages without a CDN or a build step.

The npm tarball SHA-256 is `492c32ad1815b8ff261d398e0641e97df1f85fbc78cbc0a2d77bcf45de6e5cb0`. The accompanying license is in [LICENSE](LICENSE).
